comment: Generic rule store (proof of concept). Every Marco correction becomes ONE card here, routed by 'enforce' to one of three generic paths: template (baked into the scaffold/generator - listed for the record, nothing to run), lint (deterministic assertion, executed by check_rules.py), reviewer (judgment rule + examples, retrieved by scope during the model review pass - never loaded in bulk). New scopes cost nothing; new machinery is never needed.

cards.rule: Every slide that shows a chart carries its source line (data origin, period, generator).
Every multi-series chart carries a legend naming each series.
Every slide carries its page number (NN / total).
Every bar in a bar chart carries a caption naming its case (rate, window).
Chart geometry (curve points, bar heights) comes from the unit's compute script, never drawn by hand.
cards.template_home: workflow step 5 production note + compute script pattern (chart_points.txt)

cards.rule: Any table showing returns states each row's measurement window in the row itself, not only in a footnote.
cards.bad_example: The Defender | 6.2% (windows in small print below)

cards.rule: One idea per slide; if a slide needs two 'and's in its title, it is two slides.
cards.bad_example: The rate and the years and what they mean for you
